title: High-Level Design

node_notes.logger: This is the logging facade included by the application, and it exposes ESP-IDF logging macros. firmware/utils/logger/logger.h re-exports esp_log.h.
node_notes.log_output: This is the destination for the ESP-IDF log call; the source establishes logging but does not specify a physical transport. The call originates from ESP_LOGI in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.application: This is the application startup function, and it emits the firmware-started log message. firmware/app/app.c calls ESP_LOGI with the app tag.
node_notes.entry: This is the ESP-IDF entry shim, and it starts the application by calling app_start(). The call is defined in main/entry.c.
